name: parcel_terminal
text: A person stands facing a parcel locker. Raise the right hand to tap a touchscreen at chest height, withdraw it, bend slightly and reach into an opened compartment at waist height, retrieve a small parcel and bring it to the abdomen. Left hand stays by the left thigh. Keep torso clear of the locker.
